en.title: ie in ieri (yesterday)
en.summary: The diphthong ie is found in the Romanian word ieri.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: The letter group ie sounds like /je/. You hear this sound in (ieri) /jerʲ/, which means yesterday. This letter pair makes one sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Raise the middle of your tongue high toward the roof of your mouth. Keep your lips wide and spread. Glide swiftly into an open mouth while lowering your tongue. Your vocal cords vibrate all the time. Place a hand on your throat to feel the steady vibration.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: The group ie makes the sound /je/ in most positions. You hear it in words like (fier) /fjer/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn this letter pair into two separate vowels. English words like alien or spaniel have a quick gliding sound. Keep both parts in one single breath. Never pause between the two letters.
